title: SlideGeneratorPayload
description: Input payload for generate_deck.cjs — produces a PowerPoint presentation from structured table data.

tables.description: Map of table IDs to table data extracted from Excel.

slides.description: Ordered list of slide requests. Each entry produces one slide.

sheet_name.description: Name of the Excel worksheet this table came from.

rows.description: Data rows. Each row is an array of string values matching the headers length.

header_row.description: 1-based row number of the header row in Excel.

data_end_row.description: 1-based last data row index in Excel.

table_id.description: Key referencing a table in the top-level 'tables' object.

title.description: Slide title displayed at the top.

category_index.description: 0-based column index for the X-axis / category values.

series_indexes.description: 0-based column indexes for Y-axis metric values. Required for chart types (not data_matrix).

group_by_indexes.description: 0-based column indexes to split series into sub-groups.

filters.description: Row-level filters. Keys are column indexes (as strings), values are arrays of allowed string values.

aggregation.description: How to aggregate duplicate category values.

sort_categories.description: Whether to sort category axis values (numeric-aware).

show_data_table.description: When true, displays a numeric data table beside the chart.

label_simplify.description: When true, strips dates, run IDs, and test details from labels.

label_replacements.description: Newline-separated 'from => to' rules for renaming labels. Applied before simplification.

label_max_length.description: Maximum character length for labels before truncation.

include_metadata_panel.description: Optional. When true, renders a native (non-image) Test Configuration panel on this slide using metadata_display_fields and resolved_metadata. Omit or set false for no panel and no reserved slide space — existing payloads without this field render exactly as before.

metadata_display_fields.description: Which test-configuration fields to display on this slide, in order. Only meaningful when include_metadata_panel is true. Field names are a convention, not a closed enum — any short snake_case key works as long as resolved_metadata has a matching value and generate_deck.cjs's METADATA_FIELD_LABELS (or an ad hoc label) can render it. Common fields: server, system_type (Helios/Standalone), system_variant (Helios-R/-P/-M or standalone vendor model), cpu, gpu, gpu_count, nic, direction, test, operation, collective, pipeline, transport, packet_spray, vulcano_card, fw.

resolved_metadata.description: Map of metadata field name to its display value (both as free strings) for this slide. Only fields listed in metadata_display_fields are rendered; values for fields not selected are ignored. Never invent values here — only include what the user confirmed or what was clearly and reliably identified in the workbook.

metadata_display_mode.description: Optional override for panel layout. 'auto' (default) picks a compact single-line strip for 4 or fewer fields and a fuller grouped panel otherwise. 'compact' or 'full' force that layout regardless of field count.
